items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams suffered hamstring injury, replaced by Tyson Bagent; scheduled for imaging Monday.
items.why: Hamstring on play; Bagent in; imaging Mon.
items.implication: Bagent streamer short-term; Williams status for Week 3 TBD; impacts CHI pass catchers volume/efficiency.
items.opportunity: Bagent game script; possible Odunze/Burden/Loveland checkdowns if limited mobility prior.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (cracked rib) is officially active vs. Raiders after optimism and flak jacket reports; previously GTD/questionable with Rapoport bullish tone.
items.why: Practiced Friday, improved steadily, team did not elevate WR, pushing to play; flak jacket expected.
items.implication: Remains WR2 fantasy option with possible docks for limited mobility/pain; volume intact.
items.opportunity: Primary target share if limited snaps still high efficiency.

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey (hamstring) is inactive vs. Jaguars; was questionable/not expected and led snaps Week 1.
items.why: Hamstring injury; sources indicated unlikely to play.
items.implication: Opens backfield for backups; stash/handcuff elevation.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/snaps for next man up (Jonah Coleman look).

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (stinger) questionable to return in-game today.
items.implication: Monitor return; Gainwell/handcuff elevation if out rest of way.
items.opportunity: Backup RB snaps/carries/RZ if limited or out.

items.text: McConkey ACTIVE, Harvey inactive—grab Jonah Coleman now (preseason ignore warning). Agrees Bernard stash (YAC man, Pittman out, good McCarthy fit); also Sarratt with Lane/Flowers out.
items.why: Harvey inactive opens Coleman; Pittman out + scheme fit for Bernard.
items.implication: Immediate add Coleman; Bernard deep league stash.
items.opportunity: Coleman RB opportunity/carries; Bernard WR targets/YAC.

items.text: Packers WR Jayden Reed (neck) ruled out along with RT Zach Tom (knee).
items.opportunity: Increased routes for remaining GB WRs.

items.text: Saints WR Chris Olave (hamstring) active/expected to play at Ravens; clean bill, no real docks.
items.why: Expected per Schefter/Rapoport; Levitan no docks.
items.implication: WR2/3 start with full routes expected.

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow (back) officially active and will start vs. Texans after questionable tag; expected to play all week.
items.why: Back tightness/soreness but practiced limited; coach/expected confirmation; Rapoport video on week.
items.implication: Full QB1 fantasy start in tough matchup.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers (knee/meniscus) inactive vs. Chargers; limited Friday practice, doubtful tag, expected return Week 3 vs. Saints. Michael Mayer primary replacement.
items.why: Meniscus trim Sept 8; progressing but held out to be smart; Rapoport: could return next week.
items.implication: Mayer TE streaming/spot start; Bowers stash for Week 3+.
items.opportunity: Mayer high target share as primary TE (7 tgts W1).

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins (hamstring) ruled OUT for Week 2; key early inactive impacting HOU pass game vs. Burrow/Bengals.
items.why: Hamstring on injury report, officially ruled out.
items.implication: Sit Collins; elevates other HOU WRs/TE Schultz targets.

items.text: Projecting Ladd McConkey in with decent injury docks; RapSheet tone bullish, official status late (~2:30pm ET). Puka true GTD; Olave fine no docks; Harvey->Coleman look; Pittman->Bernard look. Projections updating.
items.why: Injury reports + Rap bullish; usage opportunity in absences.
items.implication: McConkey startable with docks; handcuff/backup looks elevated.
items.opportunity: Coleman/Bernard snaps/routes/targets; McConkey volume if active.

items.text: Colts WR Michael Pittman (foot) OUT; Levitan/Berry expect decent look at Germie Bernard (YAC fit with McCarthy).
items.why: Foot injury; weekend reports confirmed out.
items.opportunity: Bernard routes/targets in Pittman absence; Roman Wilson slot.

items.text: Sunday AM status summary: McConkey GTD optimism+flak, Nacua GTD, Harvey not expected, Olave/Burrow/Black/McMillan expected (snap count), Flowers/Pittman OUT. Livestreams for last-minute.
items.why: Compiled weekend beat/injury reports for fantasy.
items.implication: Core Sunday monitoring list for actives window.
items.opportunity: Beneficiaries in OUT cases; docks for GTDs.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua (hip) true game-time/pregame decision for MNF vs. Giants; missed practice, trending concerns, Whittington doubtful.
items.why: Hip (not prior psoas); no practice Fri/Sat; Schefter pregame decision.
items.implication: Have pivot ready (TEs Ferguson/Parkinson or Konata Mumpfield/Malachi Fields); monitor warmups.
items.opportunity: If OUT, TE/WR depth chart expansion; if IN limited?

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (hamstring) ruled OUT; opens door for Rashod Bateman bigger role.
items.implication: Sit Flowers; Bateman upgrade in 3WR sets.

items.text: Marshawn Lloyd scores first career TD; congrats to those who waited over 2 years (Packers RB depth).
items.implication: Monitor for expanded role/handcuff value if Jacobs limited.

items.text: Tua Tagovailoa inactive (with Penix); listed among key early actives/inactives.
items.implication: Backup QB start impacts ATL pass game.

items.text: Bucs WR Jalen McMillan (knee) active/expected but not full-time role/snap count likely.
items.why: Expected per source but snap count reported.
items.opportunity: If ramps up, target share; else Godwin/Evans more.
